DECLARATION OF MARVELLE J. BALLENTINE IN SUPPORT OF MOTION FOR
LEAVE TO FILE CONSOLIDATED STATEMENT
I, Marvelle J. Ballentine, declare as follows:
I am the Plaintiff in this action. I make this declaration on personal knowledge.
I prepared the document attached to the accompanying motion as Exhibit A, titled
Plaintiff's Consolidated Statement of Procedural Irregularities and Judicial Actions.
3.
Every quotation in Exhibit A is reproduced from the docketed document cited
beside it. Every page citation in Exhibit A refers to the pages of the cited docketed document. The
docket entries described in Exhibit A are described as they appear on the docket of this action as
of October 30, 2026.
4.
Before April 22, 2026, I never used the name Marvelle J. Ballentine to create,
register, identify, maintain, access, or operate any account on any product or service owned or

operated by Meta Platforms, Inc. that I used. I stated this under penalty of perjury in my declaration
filed at ECF No. 31, and it remains true.
I am not a registered user of the Court's CM/ECF system and have not consented
to electronic service. I receive the Court's orders by mail at my address of record.
I declare under penalty of perjury under the laws of the United States of America that the
foregoing is true and correct.
Executed on November 1, 2026.
Marvelle J. Ballentine
